source_event.text: I’m a volunteer coordinator preparing a bilingual reminder for Arroyo Community Clinic. Please compare these texts for clarity and respectful accessibility for Spanish-speaking visitors with varied literacy levels and limited English proficiency. The wording should offer communication support neutrally, without defining recipients by what language they do not speak. The English source is: “Reminder: Your clinic visit is Tuesday, June 16, 2026, at 2:30 p.m. Please arrive 15 minutes early. If you need an interpreter or another communication accommodation, call 555-0148. These services are free.” Version A is: “Recordatorio: Su cita en la clínica es el martes 16 de junio de 2026 a las 2:30 p. m. Por favor, llegue 15 minutos antes. Si necesita un intérprete u otro apoyo para comunicarse, llame al 555-0148. Estos servicios son gratuitos.” Version B is: “Recuerde: Tiene que presentarse a la clínica el martes 16 de junio de 2026 a las 2:30 p. m. Preséntese 15 minutos anticipadamente. Si no habla inglés o requiere acomodaciones comunicativas, marque 555-0148. No se le cobrará.”
